page.title: Batch Tasks
page.subtitle: Configure once and let AI process multiple folders automatically

empty.title: No batch tasks yet
empty.desc: Create a batch task and let AI process multiple folders automatically

form.promptPlaceholder: Enter a prompt... type / to invoke skills/scenes
form.timeoutHint: Hard timeout for a single subtask run. Resuming after a pause restarts the timer.
form.notifyDesc: Push once to the configured webhook after each subtask completes, and push a summary when the whole project finishes (manage webhooks in Settings → Notifications).
form.artifactPlaceholder: One filename or wildcard per line; leave empty to skip the check
form.artifactHint: All patterns must match at the top level of the subtask directory to count as success. Glob supported: * matches any characters, ? matches a single character.
form.folderTextHint: When multi-folder selection is unstable on Linux, paste paths directly, one folder per line.

actions.allDoneOrFailed: All tasks are done or failed. Click the "{{n}} failed · reset" badge to reset and retry

confirm.deleteProjectMsg: This cannot be undone. Please confirm to continue.
confirm.startMsg: Will run {{parts}} tasks in order by concurrency (other states unaffected). Continue?
confirm.stopMsg:
Will abort all running tasks ({{running}}), and clear the session, artifacts and state of all tasks except "done" ({{target}}), resetting them to "not run".

Kept: sessions, artifacts and state of completed tasks.
Completed tasks are kept. This cannot be undone.
confirm.resetFailedQueueActive: Will clear the session, artifacts and state of {{n}} failed tasks and append them to the queue to continue. This cannot be undone. Continue?
confirm.resetFailedIdle: Will clear the session, artifacts and state of {{n}} failed tasks and reset them to "not run". You can then click "Start" to continue. This cannot be undone. Continue?
confirm.resetMsg: Will delete sessions and files of all tasks (including done) and re-run all {{n}} tasks. This cannot be undone. Continue?
confirm.rerunMsg: Will delete this task's existing session and artifacts and re-run it. This cannot be undone. Continue?
confirm.retryMsg: Will delete this task's session and files and re-run it. This cannot be undone. Continue?
confirm.deleteTaskMsg: This cannot be undone. Please confirm to continue.
